test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per the Union Budget 2025-26, Asset Monetization Plan 2025-30, what will be the amount for the second plan for 2025-30 with the aim to reinvest in new projects?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**₹10 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Asset Monetization Plan 2025-30** is a continuation of the government’s initiative to unlock value from its public sector assets and reinvest the proceeds in new infrastructure projects.
 
• The plan focuses on **raising ₹10 lakh crore** through the monetization of core assets in sectors like **transportation, energy, and urban infrastructure**.
 
• Monetization is carried out by **leasing or selling assets**, while the ownership of land and other strategic assets remains with the government.
 
• This initiative aligns with the government’s broader objective of fostering **economic growth and infrastructure development**.
 
• The revenue generated from this plan will be reinvested into **new projects under the National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP)**, which aims to modernize and expand India’s infrastructure.
 
• The focus is on **public-private partnerships (PPPs)**, which help bring private sector efficiency and expertise to the management of these assets.
 
• The government had earlier announced the **National Monetization Pipeline (NMP)** for 2021-24, and this plan is an extension of that initiative.
 
• Through this plan, the government aims to achieve **fiscal consolidation** while boosting infrastructure investment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **₹25 lakh crore**__

 __
 
• This amount might be considered for larger-scale plans or a longer timeline, but for the 2025-30 Asset Monetization Plan, the focus is on **₹10 lakh crore**.
 
 
 
• **₹15 lakh crore**__
 __
 
• Although plausible for other government initiatives, this is not the allocated amount for the **Asset Monetization Plan 2025-30.**
 
 
 
• **₹20 lakh crore**__
 
 
• Similar to the above, this amount does not correspond to the specified plan but could be part of a different financial strategy or target.
